35b32a0f:  .;
 .;This routine provides logic for editing fields in the VAS (#393)
 .;file. It contains the standard input templates and branching
 .;logic used by the KIDS utility.
5c5f9ba6: ;Go to BEGIN label.
8e12971b: ;Set up file variables and kill scratch globals.
725fe4d6: ;If field #12 is defined, save its value in DE(1).
9f9e712d: ;Kill scratch global for field #12.
40fb19e5: ;Display data label for current field.
58f17d22: ;Terminate execution.
e0de8658: ;Display data for current field, wrapping at column 45.
de0078c2: ;If field is too wide, go to word-wrapping routine.
a4bf4137: ;If field is read-only, display message and quit.
0f5f8aee: ;Read user input and store in X. Handle timeout.
db9f16e7: ;Terminate execution.
7108661d: ;Increment data level and kill corresponding array.
193472a9: ;Branch to the next data level.
fb414af3: ;If DE array is defined, go to PR label, else read input.
1d21d204: ;If null input, branch based on response variable.
28a96123: ;If help requested, branch to appropriate routine.
c9eb915c: ;If restart requested, branch to restart routine.
8ce984bf: ;If user enters @, retrieve default value from ^DISV.
46999570: ;If response variable is not null, perform code transforms.
ca22d708: ;If no match found in DU string, scan for possible matches.
7f248875: ;If no matches found, display remainder of DU string.
60d4ab4b: ;If response variable is P for Pointer, perform lookup in file.
4878a4c1: ;If response variable is N for Numeric, perform data validation.
a4434f8e: ;If data type is numeric, remove leading zeros.
4dea839e: ;Execute code transform for current data level.
4acfc600: ;Save new value in global and possibly in ^DISV("DIE")
048de7b6: ;If DB array is defined, branch to Z^DIE17 label
f7e86443: ;Default X to '?BAD'
7873edea: ;Set DZ=X, call D label, call QQ^DIEQ, go to B label
84a9baf1: ;Set D=DIFLD, set DQ(DQ)=DLB_U_DV_U_DU_U_DW_U_description from X_DQ routine
8435ae72: ;If DE(DQ) is undefined, call O label, branch to RD if X doesn't equal '@', branch to A if DV doesn't contain 'R' and X='@', else set X='@' and go to N
89137e83: ;Set DG=DV, Y=DE(DQ), X=DU. If DQ(DQ,2) is defined, execute code at that location and branch to RP

0667e266: ;If DG contains 'P' and global root ^X exists, set X to IEN #2 of ^X(0), go to RP if ^(Y,0) is undefined, else set Y=$P(^(0),U), X to caption from DD(X,.01,0), DG to piece 2 of ^DD(X,.01,0) and branch to R

740fb1fd: ;If DG contains 'V', Y is numeric, $P(Y,';',2) contains '(', and global root specified exists, set X to IEN #2 of that global root, go to RP if ^(+Y,0) is undefined, else set Y=$P(^(0),U). If DD(+X,.01,0) exists, set DG=$P(^(0),U,2), X=$P(^(0),U,3) and branch to R
404c142e: ;If DG contains 'D', execute ^DD('DD') code. If DG contains 'S', set Y=$P($P(';'_X,';'_Y_':',2),';') if result is non-null
5fca4bd6: ;If X is blank, set X to data from file entry;call Die 17 if no data, or if DC<2; Quit if DC>=2.
e0629976: ;If DV does not contain 'I' or '#', go to RD (READ).
8f577a23: ;Call DIE0 to load/edit data; If data in X, go to RD; else go to PR.
acf21e42: ;Quit routine.
5a8aeed2: ;Set routine name and initialize DQ (data quality) field.
e0ba1dcc: ;Set DW, DV, DU, DLB, and DIFLD variables for Physician field.
59d4efb0: ;Set DU variable for file 200 lookup.
a9aaf287: ;Set X to value of DGJTPR.
af57999e: ;Set Y to value of X.
40bc9873: ;If X is blank call DIE 17; If DV has 'I' or '#' call DIE0; If no data in X after DIE0, go to A.
852bf452: ;If X has data, go to Z; else go to RD.
ad2562af: ;Quit this section.

If more than 9 levels of FileMan calling,
call special DIE17 utility F^DIE17,
then go to next routine DGJXA9.
